entities.name: Corriere dei Piccoli
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Corriere dei Piccoli, later nicknamed Corrierino, was a weekly magazine for children published in Italy from 1908 to 1995. It was the first Italian periodical to make a regular feature of publishing comic strips.
